title: Conectar jornadas PostgreSQL às rotas públicas

scope.goal: Wire PostgresJourneyRepository into the public journey routes preserving auth/tenant/error behavior; fail startup closed when a postgres journey adapter cannot be constructed; run migration 0014 at postgres startup; prove HTTP behavior and restart reads against the disposable fixture.
scope.fixtures: synthetic only; disposable PostgreSQL 127.0.0.1:55432/cvg_aaa16_test; operational port 5432 never used
scope.public_api: unchanged route paths, envelopes and status codes
scope.safety: draft-only journeys; no real confirmation/reschedule/cancel; no clinical, financial or production action

changes: createPersistence(config, journeyRepository) now returns a concrete PostgresJourneyRepository for postgres and postgres-pool instead of journeys: null
createPostgresJourneyRepository fails startup with an explicit error when pool/client cannot carry tenant-scoped operations (no cast hiding a missing adapter)
singleConnectionPool adapts a checked-out direct client to the PostgresPoolLike contract used by withTenantContext
all journey route handlers await the port uniformly (owner/patient search, drafts create/list, link, slots, appointment drafts, journey tasks)
POSTGRES_AUTO_MIGRATE now always runs runPostgresMigrations (checksum-guarded set including 0014_journeys) instead of the initial-only runner for non-RLS postgres
new optional BuildServerOptions.journeyRepository override (JourneyRepositoryPort | null) for controlled tests; null keeps routes fail-closed
existing unavailable-repository test now passes journeyRepository: null explicitly; same intent, same assertions (postgres mode with no journey repository fails closed with invalid_action)

migration.name: 0014_journeys
migration.startup_path: POSTGRES_AUTO_MIGRATE=true -> runPostgresMigrations (checksum guard) in both RLS and legacy postgres modes
migration.startup_proof_test: journeys-api-postgres.test.ts > applies migration 0014 during postgres startup before serving journeys

factory_modes.postgres-pool: new PostgresJourneyRepository(pool) — tenant-scoped withTenantContext + RLS path
factory_modes.override: options.journeyRepository wins for controlled tests; null exposes the fail-closed unavailable state
factory_modes.fail_closed: createPostgresJourneyRepository throws before the server is built when the configured postgres adapter lacks pool.connect or client.query

acceptance_checklist.factory_uses_concrete_repository: createPersistence returns PostgresJourneyRepository for postgres and postgres-pool; journeys: null placeholder removed from the factory
acceptance_checklist.no_cast_hiding_missing_adapter: createPostgresJourneyRepository validates pool.connect/client.query and throws 'PostgreSQL journey persistence requires …' at startup; no 'as unknown as' for journeys
acceptance_checklist.memory_mode_preserved: memory mode still constructs JourneyRepository; all pre-existing memory journey tests unchanged and passing
acceptance_checklist.routes_work_over_http_on_postgres: 8/8 new tests; full owner/patient/link/slots/appointment/task journey over postgres-pool, plus direct-client adapter path
acceptance_checklist.auth_preserved: missing identity 401 and invalid role 401 asserted over postgres
acceptance_checklist.tenant_isolation_preserved: cross-tenant owner list, patient draft and link denied (not_found / not listed); owner search cannot surface another tenant candidate ids
acceptance_checklist.validation_errors_preserved: invalid phone validation_failed 400, invalid candidateId validation_failed 400, unknown patient draft 404, stale slot conflict 409
acceptance_checklist.approval_boundary_preserved: appointment drafts remain awaiting_approval/confirmationBlocked=true; no confirm route (404)
acceptance_checklist.migration_0014_at_startup: startup test verifies 0014 checksum row after POSTGRES_AUTO_MIGRATE and serves journeys afterwards
acceptance_checklist.restart_reads: second app + second pool over the same schema reads owner/patient/appointment state and verifies the row directly
acceptance_checklist.unavailable_repository_fails_closed: route-level test with journeyRepository: null returns invalid_action 400 on all journey routes; startup test rejects unusable adapters

restart_read_evidence.test: journeys-api-postgres.test.ts > reads created journey state back after a server restart
steps: first buildServer over firstPool creates owner draft, linked patient, appointment draft and reads slots
new secondPool over the same schema and new secondApp
secondApp lists owner (draft), patient (linked) and appointment (awaiting_approval, confirmationBlocked=true, same slot) state
